pulgaon.overview: Pulgaon is one of Durg's established residential and industrial-adjacent localities, part of the Bhilai–Durg twin-city agglomeration. It offers more affordable inventory than central Bhilai while staying close to NH 53 and Durg's railway and civic infrastructure.
pulgaon.connectivity: On NH 53/NH 6, with Durg Junction railway station around 10–15 minutes away; Raipur's Swami Vivekananda Airport is roughly 45–50 minutes by road.
pulgaon.socialInfra: Schools: Pt. JLN Government schools network, local DPS/CBSE-affiliated schools. Hospitals: District Hospital Durg, nearby private clinics. Retail: Durg's central market and Pulgaon's local retail strip.
pulgaon.techParks: Durg shares its industrial base with neighboring Bhilai (Bhilai Steel Plant and ancillary units) and hosts additional small-to-mid scale manufacturing along the NH 53 belt.
pulgaon.upcomingInfra: Civic road and drainage upgrades under Durg's Smart City programme, alongside continued NH 53 corridor improvements shared with the Bhilai side of the agglomeration.

priceTrend.comparisonNote: One of the more affordable localities in the Bhilai–Durg belt, with modest, steady appreciation.

rentalYield.note: Stable rental demand from a mix of railway, government, and local industry employees.

faq.q: Is RERA registration required for projects in Durg?
faq.a: Yes — Durg, like the rest of Chhattisgarh, falls under CG-RERA. Verify any project's registration number on the CG-RERA portal before booking, and confirm the promoter name matches who you're paying.

faq.q: What is the average price per sq.ft. in Pulgaon, Durg?
faq.a: Around ₹2,600 per sq.ft. as of this update, among the more affordable price points in the Bhilai–Durg twin-city belt, with close to 5% year-on-year growth.

faq.q: How is Durg different from Bhilai for property buyers?
faq.a: Durg and Bhilai function as a single urban agglomeration but Durg tends to offer more affordable inventory and is the administrative/railway-junction side of the twin city, while Bhilai is more directly anchored to the steel plant township.

faq.q: What legal documents should I check before buying in Pulgaon?
faq.a: Title deed and ownership chain, encumbrance certificate, approved building plan, and confirmation of clear municipal records (khata/mutation) before registration.
